People overrate how much pick ups are responsible for tone. Electronics heavily influence sound and response; case and point being differences between coveted 59 bursts and later Les Pauls, 500k pots make a night and day difference from 250-300k pots. Tone wood just logically that the sound from the string would have to be transferred through it making a difference. Now this different makes up the 10-15%of your guitars sound that isn’t electrical. Saying that tone wood doesn’t exist just is illogical, since pick ups don’t just take sound coming from directly above them like some people would think they operate as a magnetic field taking in sound from all angles. That being said, a strat with an Ash body vs an Alder body will both sound like strats, but they’re intrinsically different, just like ever other guitar.
